name: frost-agent-runner
description: Frost Night Factory Agent Runner - Runs on your local machine

scripts.costs:report: tsx -e "import { CostTracker } from './lib/cost-tracker'; const stats = CostTracker.getStatistics(); console.log('Total Spent:', '$' + stats.totalSpent.toFixed(2)); console.log('Avg Cost:', '$' + stats.averageCostPerPipeline.toFixed(4)); console.log('Total Pipelines:', stats.totalPipelines); console.log('Most Expensive Step:', stats.mostExpensiveStep);"
